FAQ

WhatsApp automation, explained.

What is WhatsApp automation?

WhatsApp automation means an AI agent replies to your customers on WhatsApp for you. It answers questions, qualifies leads, takes bookings and orders, sends reminders and alerts your team, 24/7.

Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?

For a full AI agent, yes. We set up the official WhatsApp Business Platform (API) for you through Meta, verify your business and connect it to your agent. You keep your brand name and number.

Can I keep my current WhatsApp number?

Usually yes. A number can move to the WhatsApp Business Platform, but it can then no longer be used in the normal WhatsApp app at the same time. We guide you through the options before switching.

Does Meta charge for WhatsApp messages?

Meta charges per message for some template messages, such as marketing and utility messages you send first. Replies inside a customer-started conversation are typically free. Any Meta fees are passed through at cost.

Is WhatsApp automation allowed in the UAE?

Yes. Using the official WhatsApp Business Platform is fully supported in the UAE. We follow Meta's policies, such as only messaging customers who opted in.

Can my team still reply on WhatsApp?

Yes. Your team sees every conversation and can take over any chat. The AI steps back as soon as a human replies.
